comment: Known test results in the isolated harness environment (Node 22, the image below), reviewed by the owner: 6 genuine failures and 1 failing todo test ("kind": "todo", a test declared { todo } for a documented known bug, which node:test does not count as a failure). Recorded on the unchanged base. scripts/verify-refactor.js requires EXACTLY these to fail, on base and on every head run, each with a matching signature and kind (a todo entry must be a failing todo, every other entry a genuine failure); any other failure or failing todo, a changed signature or kind, or a known entry that passes blocks. Not fixed by any refactor: see docs/TODO.md (Node 22 compatibility).

failures.name: a printer that is not there is reported as unreachable, not as a wrong code
failures.exact:
The input did not match the regular expression /refused|reach|timeout/i. Input:

'connection closed before MQTT handshake completed'

failures.name: files: list, metadata palette, thumbnail, upload, identity check, delete
failures.reason: upload byte count: the multipart boundary has a random length (connectors/http-utils.js:174), so the two numbers vary between runs; everything else in the message is fixed

failures.name: hotend shows the active head, not a parked head that is preheating
failures.exact:
Expected values to be strictly equal:

30 !== 215
failures.reason: declared { todo: ... } in test/connectors/virtual-u1.test.js: a documented known bug (probe() picks the first heating head, not the active one); it also failed as a todo on Node 24.21.0 (G0a, 2026-11-14), so it is not a Node 22 compatibility failure
